description: Configure a GPIO pin on `agent` by number. type: input/output/vcc/gnd/remove. init: 0/1/last. pullup: up/down/none (input only). max: max pulse duration in seconds (output only). reversed: active-low logic (input/output only). watched: trigger webhook on state change (logged on the agent if no notifications.webhook is configured).
name: mcp_gpio_config
